Metadata.title: Quina
Metadata.description: Organize your store's credit: every neighbor with their own terms, Quina calculates what they owe and collects for you.

Home.title: Your credit notebook, organized
Home.lead: We're getting your counter ready. Soon you'll be able to register your store and start giving credit with clear rules.

otp.subject: Your code to sign in to Quina
otp.intro: Use this code to confirm your email and keep setting up your store:
otp.outro: The code expires in 15 minutes. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email.

reset.subject: Choose a new password for Quina
reset.intro: You asked to change the password of your Quina account. Tap the button to choose a new one:
reset.outro: The link expires in 30 minutes and can be used only once. If it wasn't you, do nothing: your password stays the same.

lockout.subject: We're protecting your Quina account
lockout.intro: There were 5 failed sign-in attempts on your account, so we locked it for 15 minutes.
lockout.outro: If it was you, wait 15 minutes and try again. If not, reset your password as soon as possible with "Forgot my password" to keep your account safe.

customers.title: {store}'s privacy policy for its customers
customers.draft: Legal draft: this text is pending review by a lawyer.
customers.intro: {store} uses Quina to keep track of its customers' store credit. Here we explain what data about you it keeps, why, and how you can ask to correct or delete it, under Peruvian Law No. 29733 on Personal Data Protection.
customers.ownerTitle: Who is responsible for your data?
customers.owner: The data controller is {store}, {taxIdType} {taxId}. You can write to {email}.
customers.processor: Quina, a product by Andeva, is the data processor: it keeps the data on secure servers on behalf of the store, does not use it for anything else and never sells it.
customers.data: Your ID document, first and last names, mobile phone, email, address if you gave it, your preferred language, your credit terms (limit, rates, cut-off and payment dates) and the record of your credit purchases and payments.
customers.purpose: Only to manage your store credit account: record your purchases and payments, calculate your installments and interest, send you your statement and payment reminders, and let you check your account.
customers.retention: While you have an account with the store and, afterwards, for as long as the law requires sales and payment records to be kept.
customers.rights: You can ask to access your data, correct it, cancel it or object to its use. Write to the store at {email} or ask at the counter. If you get no answer, you can go to the National Authority for Personal Data Protection of the Ministry of Justice.
customers.notFound: Check the link you were given.
